result_status: No full-scale researcher comparison or 100-task application-cell result is available in this merged evidence snapshot.

measurement_policy.measured: An observed local or provider execution with a retained public receipt; each claim remains limited to its stated task, software, and control.
measurement_policy.offline_candidate: A pinned source inventory or reproducible offline split; no task admission, GUI success, or model score follows from its count.
measurement_policy.planned: A declared future workload or budget ceiling, not an execution, invoice, or success denominator.
measurement_policy.unverified: A gate without qualifying evidence in this snapshot; do not convert it to a zero model score.

merged_snapshot_progress.interpretation: Counts describe receipts present at the specified merged commit, not a live job monitor or a model failure rate.

application_qualification.candidate_unit: PPT-Eval task IDs across 12 source-deck families
application_qualification.offline_split: 20 selection and 100 provisional final candidates, deck-family disjoint
application_qualification.observed_scope: One 32-slide source deck was edited and saved in the real web app. An Office-saved no-task-change control and requested 48-point title edit differ in five package parts; a narrowly normalized artifact guard conditionally accepts the edit.
application_qualification.missing_gate: Automated pre-actor baseline freeze, task reset, and a reliable upstream official score remain unverified.

application_qualification.candidate_unit: SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial_Model and Debugging task instances from 30 base-workbook families
application_qualification.offline_split: 20 selection candidates from three families and 100 provisional final candidates from 15 different families
application_qualification.observed_scope: A complex source workbook opened and retained checked cell semantics on an untouched download, but lost two Note drawings. A separate six-sheet SEC-based development workbook has one human GUI full-positive and one partial negative control.
application_qualification.missing_gate: No provisional final task has a complete web-GUI repair, full preservation proof, hidden isolation, and automated reset.

application_qualification.candidate_unit: OSWorld task IDs across ten application domains; Calc contributes 47 IDs
application_qualification.observed_scope: One E2B Desktop sandbox used LibreOffice Calc GUI to save a synthetic XLSX; independent OOXML readback matched both cells, and the sandbox was confirmed stopped.
application_qualification.missing_gate: No OSWorld task, task-specific evaluator, or task reset ran; LibreOffice is not Microsoft Excel desktop.

application_qualification.candidate_unit: WorkArena L2 task classes; seeds are instances within a class
application_qualification.observed_scope: Pinned source inventory plus a post-merge gated-access request that was submitted and awaiting author review. No ServiceNow instance access or task execution is verified.
application_qualification.missing_gate: Approved benchmark-instance access and live task, verifier, and reset checks.

application_qualification.candidate_unit: WebArena-Verified GitLab task IDs from 41 intent templates
application_qualification.observed_scope: A read-only navigation task on an unseeded local GitLab CE instance scored 1/0/1. A separate published milestone mutation task 590 scored 1/0/1 for correct/wrong-date/correct GUI submissions on a minimal synthetic local project; PostgreSQL readback and three monitored resets passed. Neither case used a model.
application_qualification.missing_gate: The original populated WebArena project state, realistic current-date tasks, broader mutation reset, and 100-task task-by-task admission.

application_qualification.observed_scope: Task 157 read-only navigation had positive/wrong-route controls; a Qwen3.8-27B base-model attempt scored 1 on that single task. Task 538 address mutation had official positive 1.0, wrong-order negative 0.0, independent database readback, and post-test restoration of five monitored business-table hashes. A separate five-variant price task 777 was rejected: the network-only official score was 1.0, but the GUI showed a save error and SQL confirmed zero persisted price changes.
application_qualification.missing_gate: Reliable persisted saves for other mutation families, general reset, and 100-task admission; the one base-model success is not a trained-checkpoint or full-cell result.

spreadsheetbench_2_structural_screen.interpretation: The 100 candidates share 15 base models; neither the task count nor the structural thresholds establish GUI solvability or hidden-set novelty.

sec_blind_audit_development_fixture.interpretation: The one-edit and full-repair controls discriminate incomplete repair on one public development fixture. They do not measure model difficulty or create sealed final tasks.

student_interface_evidence.interpretation: Synthetic-image LoRA compatibility and one base-model navigation success are separate checks; no before/after training effect is measured.

suggested_figures.form: two-bar repair-count comparison with an independent-oracle annotation
suggested_figures.annotation: The full downloaded workbook passed 114/114 formula targets and two evaluator-side source/scenario replay profiles. Their vectors are public in this development fixture. Both controls are human-operated, with zero model calls.

suggested_figures.title: A network success signal contradicted the persisted business state
suggested_figures.form: two evidence cards with distinct units, not a common-axis score chart
suggested_figures.caption: In one isolated Magento clone, the unchanged official HAR evaluator returned 1.0, while the UI reported a save error and five target prices remained unchanged. This is an environment-specific rejection, not a general benchmark score.

publication_cautions: Title the artifact as an interim qualification or methods report. Do not call it the completed four-by-six result paper.
Do not pool Magento protocol-development scores 0, 0, unscored, 1 as independent model trials; protocol versions and failure modes differ.
Do not count the SEC human positive as a Qwen result, a hidden final item, or automated cloud-reset evidence.
Do not equate 100 provisional Excel task instances with 100 independent workbooks; they derive from 15 final base families.
Do not treat E2B Calc as Microsoft Excel desktop or its synthetic XLSX smoke as an OSWorld task.
Do not treat the GitLab milestone task on a minimal synthetic local project with past 2023 dates as the original populated WebArena environment or a realistic final task.
Do not promote the Magento task 777 network-only score of 1.0 to an admitted task success; the GUI reported a save error and the target prices did not persist in that clone.
Do not treat a source's published task count as a runtime-ready denominator; inventory units differ across cells.
The ServiceNow access request is a separately registered post-merge browser observation; it is not instance approval or a task run.
Actual provider billing, complete 100-task scores, model improvement, and all-cell reset coverage are unavailable.
